name: std::basic_istream<CharT,Traits>::sync
intro:
Synchronizes the input buffer with the associated data source.

Behaves as UnformattedInputFunction, except that gcount() is not affected. After constructing and checking the sentry object,

If rdbuf() is a null pointer, returns -1.

Otherwise, calls rdbuf()->pubsync(). If that function returns -1, calls setstate(badbit) and returns -1. Otherwise, returns 0.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: 0 on success, -1 on failure or if the stream does not support this operation (is unbuffered).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: As with readsome(), it is implementation-defined whether this function does anything with library-supplied streams. The intent is typically for the next read operation to pick up any changes that may have been made to the associated input sequence after the stream buffer last filled its get area. To achieve that, sync() may empty the get area, or it may refill it, or it may do nothing. A notable exception is Visual Studio, where this operation discards the unprocessed input when called with a standard input stream.
